text: Find rock, deep in dirt, rock cold uranium. This not normal rock. Tell childhood friend
Grook to smell rock. Grook die. Rock got angry magic, but can't see magic. It too tiny.
But if smart man split rock, tiny part go crazy. One rock yell, over yell louder. Then suddenly,
boom. Not small boom. Biggest boom since volcano eat tribe chief first wife. To build skyfire bomb,
tribe need. Big brain man who read. Enchanted gray tube and 10,000 money from cave government.
Now put angry rock inside metal ball. Bow then go in tube to sleep.
Smart man build thing called trigger. Fancy name for clicky clicky fire now. Trigger use science
magic to press rock very hard until rock lose temper. Uranium like ex-girlfriend not stable.
And if you push, everything explode way out of proportion. When bomb go boom, sky turn white.
If dark, it turn moon time back to sun time. You look, no no see again. You near, no no you again.
You far away. Fire wind get you, hair go bye bye, and you go cough cough cough.
After first big boom, tribe say. This bad, we never do again.
We make 10 more. Now other big tribe make many big boom. We say we no use unless you use.
Other tribe say. Same. Skyfire rock, most powerful thing me ever make. Also dumbest.
Like make giant spear that stab at both end. So lesson is, maybe not split magic rock.
Maybe stick to fire. Fire only cook food. Magic rock, cook planet.
